head: 8aa3ca4347f6f4e2f08cc161466dc20cc746212c
title: fix(dispatch): fail-fast stale candidate baseline before clone/Pane (#147)
body: 派发前校验候选基线是否为 dev 祖先（方案 A）：stale 即拒并给出 dev 前进数与 rebase/新基线处置，拒绝发生在 intent-claim 之后、clone/Pane 创建之前，落 failed 任务 + finish intent + 释放预留，零孤儿。未知 git 状态 fail-open，FR-6.2 保持 fail-closed 兜底。

head: 291c1f75987ff82f56ec9ac5dc598441f4461543
title: fix(workflow): fix-loop 对已终结 Task 重复下发并扣预算 (#158)
body:
后继代任务(test-01-r4)重记录与 test-01-r3 相同的 blocked 结论时, verdict_fingerprint 因含易失 task_id 判为新 verdict,repeat 检测失配; 闩释放又清掉 |fp 与计数,同一结论可用新预算无限重开循环,逐轮作废已终结任务并扣预算。

- verdict_fingerprint 去除 task_id 维度:语义由 branch+note+affected 承担,目标敏感性不受影响(PR #110 语义保留)
- _fix_loop_latch_blocks 释放路径保留 |fp:计数归零仍给 redo 新预算,但重记录的同一结论走 repeat_verdict 升级,不再进入新一轮扣减

head: 42ab1b32d9918b735421d1cee95752c7edd598e8
title: fix(dispatch): resolve defects #1, #3, #4, #6, #7 and refine router rejection semantics (#149)
body:
- #4: add 'sign-off' to NOTE_KINDS and CONTEXT_KINDS in workflow_docs.py
- #7: distinguish isolation vs health/policy rejections in agent_router.py; abort launch intent and release reservation instead of persisting failed task on router health failure, avoiding node capacity locking
- #3: remove misleading isolation opt-out hint on router health rejections, provide actionable deep-preflight suggestion
- #6: print proposed and existing task_id explicitly on DISPATCH DUPLICATE
- #1: add herdr-task freeze-candidate CLI command for candidate re-freezing
